project: GolfSol Ireland premium Vite app redesign
sitePositioning: Premium Costa del Sol golf holidays for Irish travellers with packages, hotels, tee times, and transfers.
designGoal: Replicate the supplied mockup as a real working Vite/React website theme across the entire existing app while keeping routes and logic intact.

visualPrinciples.style: cream luxury travel UI with forest green panels and yellow/gold conversion accents
visualPrinciples.density: rich but clean, card-based, premium spacing
visualPrinciples.motion: subtle fade-up, lift, zoom, and soft glow interactions
visualPrinciples.imagery: cinematic Costa del Sol golf courses, mountains, Mercedes V-Class/Sprinter, palm resorts, clubhouse hospitality

header.logoTreatment: crest left, MALAGA · COSTA DEL SOL wordmark, GOLF TRANSFERS subline

hero.headline: FROM PLANE TO FAIRWAY.
hero.subheading: Mercedes transfers. Golf-bag friendly. Your group looked after, gate to fairway.
hero.backgroundInstruction: Use golf course + mountain + Mercedes image with deep green overlay. If separate images exist, layer Mercedes image to right on desktop and lower hero on mobile.

featureStrip.style: dark green floating rounded card overlapping hero bottom

airportSection.title: Arrive in Malaga. Let Us Do The Rest.
airportSection.copy: Meet and greet at the airport, live flight awareness, room for clubs, then straight on to your hotel.

tripBuilder.title: Design Your Costa del Sol Golf Trip
tripBuilder.subtitle: Choose your destination · Choose your golf course · Choose your accommodation

adminDashboard.sidebar: cream sidebar with active pale highlight and dark green text
adminDashboard.cards: ivory rounded cards with thin border and clean stat hierarchy
adminDashboard.tables: compact rounded rows, status pills, green/gold state colours

clientDashboard.bookingCard: large rounded ivory card with date tile, route, passenger, vehicle, status, and download button

forms.inputs: rounded fields, subtle border, green focus ring
forms.submit: gold full-width or pill button with dark green text

businessCards.landscape: cream front with crest, forest back with gold details and QR
businessCards.portrait: dark green luxury card with crest top, Mercedes/golf texture, contact icons, QR bottom

implementationChecklist: Add/import crest logo asset and use it in header, admin, client dashboard, mobile nav, business cards, and email templates.
Create or update global Tailwind design tokens/classes.
Restyle hero to match mockup exactly.
Restyle all cards, buttons, inputs, nav, tables, tabs, and badges.
Make admin and client pages cream/green, not generic SaaS.
Ensure mobile homepage strongly matches uploaded mobile mockup style.
Run npx tsc --noEmit and npm run build.
Do not break existing live logic.
